map.根据当前 pH、目标 pH、土壤缓冲系数与面积，估算石灰（提高 pH）或硫磺（降: From current pH, target pH, soil buffer coefficient, and area, estimate lime (raise pH) or sulfur (lower pH) amount.
map.石灰用量（kg）=（目标 pH − 当前 pH）× 缓冲系数 × 面积；pH 需: Lime amount (kg) = (target pH - current pH) x buffer coefficient x area; applies when raising pH
map.需降低 pH 时估算硫磺用量约为石灰用量的 30%-35%（按纯物质折算）: When lowering pH, sulfur amount ~30%-35% of lime amount (by pure substance)
map.不同土壤质地、有机质含量对缓冲系数影响大，建议结合土壤检测: Soil texture and organic matter strongly affect buffer coefficient; combine with soil testing
map.石灰用量 ≈ 目标 pH 与现状差值 × 土壤缓冲容量 × 面积（经验曲线查表）: Lime amount ~ (target - current pH) x soil buffer capacity x area (empirical curve lookup).
map.酸性土施石灰升 pH，碱性土施硫磺降 pH。: Acid soil: apply lime to raise pH; alkaline soil: apply sulfur to lower pH.
map.用于改良酸化耕地、优化根系养分吸收。: For improving acidified farmland and optimizing root nutrient uptake.
map.现状 pH 5.2，目标 6.5，差值 1.3；粘壤土缓冲较强，经验石灰需要量约: Current pH 5.2, target 6.5, diff 1.3; clay loam buffers strongly, empirical lime need ~150 kg/(mu·pH). This use ~ 1.3 x 150 ~ 195 kg/mu. Sandy soil buffers weakly, halve the amount.
map.不建议一次大剂量。大调幅应分 2~3 年施用，并翻耕混匀，避免局部碱化烧根。施后: Not recommended in one large dose. Large adjustments over 2-3 years, plowed and mixed, to avoid local alkalization burning roots. Re-test pH 2-4 weeks after application before top-up.
map.为什么测的是 pH 不是酸度？: Why measure pH rather than acidity?
map.pH 是对数指标，同样降 0.1 个 pH 单位，酸性土所需石灰远多于中性土，因: pH is logarithmic; lowering by 0.1 unit needs far more lime in acid than neutral soil due to buffering. So amount follows buffer curve, not simple difference.
